entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet I bought. Your whole system is a nightmare.
I'm very sorry for the wait time, I can definitely help you with that return. Can I start with your order number, please?
It's VF-8675309. I don't want any hassle, I just want my money back now. This is ridiculous.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see the Trail Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is the color is hideous! It looks nothing like it did online. It's been sitting in its box unopened since the day I got it. I'm not wearing it, and if I don't wear it, that's a safety issue, isn't it? Just process the return or get me your manager.

I understand your frustration with the color, and there's no need for a manager, I can certainly handle this for you. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we truly appreciate your business. Let me just check the delivery date here.
You'd better. I spend a lot of money here. If this doesn't get resolved, I'll make sure everyone on social media knows how VeloFit treats its 'VIP' customers.
I completely understand. Okay, I see the helmet was delivered 63 days ago. And you confirmed the box is still unopened, correct?
Yes! Unopened! Are you going to help me or are you just going to keep asking me questions?

Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I am processing the return for a full refund for you right now. I've just initiated it, and you'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes.
Fine. That's what should have happened from the start.
I agree, and my apologies again for the frustration. For the inconvenience, and as a thank you for being a loyal VIP customer, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Oh. A credit. Okay, well, thank you. That's better. I'll watch for the email.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
